# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Ezconnect

Ezconnect is a universal React Native application powered by Expo SDK 57, React 19, and React Native 0.86.

## Mandatory Guidelines
- Consult the AI documentation hub in `ai/README.md`.
- Obey all guardrails in `ai/guardrails.md`.
- Maintain architecture consistency with `ai/architecture.md`.
- Adhere to Expo SDK 57 modern APIs in `ai/expo-v57-guide.md`.
- Update `ai/*.md` documentation whenever code structure, routes, components, or hooks change (`ai/documentation-maintenance.md`).
